assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has intermittent symptoms and a need to evaluate for potential arrhythmias contributing to hemodynamic instability.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to correlate clinical events with cardiac rhythm disturbances.
CPT code 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
The diagnosis code I25.10 is supported.
The diagnosis code I34.0 is supported.
The diagnosis code R42 is supported.
